newsitem.title: USA: Wellsford Residential to spin off unit.
newsitem.headline: Wellsford Residential to spin off unit.

text.p: Wellsford Residential Property Trust on Tuesday said it planned to spin off its Wellsford Real Properties Inc subsidiary to shareholders.

The spin-off is to be carried out through a stock dividend payable to its shareholders on May 30, immediately before the completion of its acquisition by Equity Residential Properties Trust, the company said.
Payment of the dividend is subject to the completion of the merger, it said.
For each Wellsford Residential share, shareholders will receive 0.25 of a common share of Wellsford Real Properties, and cash will be paid in lieu of fractional shares, it said.
The common shares of Wellsford Real Properties -- a real estate investment firm and property developer -- have been approved for listing on the American Stock Exchange under the symbol "WRP."
Assuming approval of shareholders of Wellsford Residential and Equity Residential on May 28, the merger is expected to become effective on May 30, it said.
